attempts.summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted volume on node1 backed by a loop-mounted file (/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img), unlocked via a root-only keyfile (/etc/secure-volume.key), formatted XFS, and wired it to auto-unlock and mount at /srv/secure on boot via a systemd oneshot unit (srv-secure.service, enabled, WantedBy=local-fs.target). Verified end-to-end by rebooting node1: boot_id changed confirming a real restart, and the service automatically re-unlocked and remounted the volume with the pre-existing marker data intact.
